scope: dreaming prompt settings and request composition
rationale: User-requested editable pass instructions and correction of the unused general_prompt setting. Historical Python fixtures remain unchanged.
additions: workflows.<pass>.prompt is a string override; absent, empty or whitespace uses the built-in pass instruction
GET /api/settings/dream returns default_prompts for the seven passes
Settings and dashboard workflow projections include prompt
runtime: Configured LLM passes combine the saved general_prompt and their own override or default. Budget calculation and audit hashing use the same rendered prompt that is sent. JSON schema, source ID constraints and domain authority/evidence checks remain enforced.
